doc.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009

title: President Obama and Coltrane
summary: Ali is delighted that Obama spoke of giving 'A Love Supreme' to his brother-in-law; he muses about playing the White House.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: I see. How are we doing for time, Mary? Eight minutes? You know it feels really good to be able to say President Obama these days.
About eight days he’s been, eight or nine days. I wonder how — you guys have any —

It feels even better because Obama says he likes John Coltrane. You know that’s even feeling better, because he said, in one of his speeches, that he gave his brother-in-law “A Love Supreme.” Because he was playing, see he was playing a lot of music, man, he’d say, “Now I really want you to hear something.” He’s trying to get his music together. He said “I want you to really hear something really great.” So he said, “I gave him John Coltrane’s ‘A Love Supreme’.” So right there, when Obama said that I go like wow, this cat is into the music. So it’s very possible he could have “Interstellar Space” there in his house or something. You know? Because he openly spoke of John Coltrane, and I never ever heard a president speak of John Coltrane. You know? So that also, why I went oh wow, we’ve really got somebody in the White House, it’s really possible — Cecil Taylor played in the White House, I think it was under Bill Clinton, because he had a saxophone, you know, Bill Clinton had a saxophone. In fact I got his CD, Bill Clinton’s CD when he played saxophone.
I didn’t know such a thing existed.

Yeah. It did. And I bought it right away and I never played it. I figure I played it once, but I just kept it for archives. And so like Obama’s talking about Coltrane, so like it could be possible one day to play the White House. It would be great.
Yeah. Avant garde at the White House.
Yeah, because he definitely said that he was giving his brother-in-law “A Love Supreme.” He said that. I went like wow. So Obama is really, he’s really the cat and he’s trying to do it all.
